boss.act.name: You say his name. Just his name, quietly, the way you'd say it across a kitchen table. For one second the arena stops. 'Don't,' says Noah, small and high and green around the edges. 'Nobody says it like that anymore.'
boss.act.noeffect: You say his name. Whoever is standing there doesn't turn around. It's not the right one.
boss.act.check.1: NOAH. He is shaking so hard his scarf trembles. He doesn't want to do this. He can't stop.
boss.act.check.2: NOAH. Something is wearing his smile, and it is enjoying itself.
boss.act.check.3: NOAH. The shadows in the room are bending toward him like he's a fire.
boss.act.check.4: NOAH. There is no single person left to look at. Only the sum of everything.
boss.noheal: There is nothing left to eat, drink or hold on to.
boss.mercy.locked: Not yet. He is still swinging.
boss.phase.2: The air turns yellow. The smile changes hands.
boss.phase.3: The air turns red. The room remembers every wall it has ever had.
boss.tesseract: The cube opens like a mouth. Every word in the air forgets what it was going to say, and for three long seconds the room is only yours.
boss.beat.begin3: Now you'll see what is under the floor.
boss.beat.thr50.2: Hm. You hit harder than you look.
boss.beat.thr50.3: Is that all you've got? Come on. COME ON.
boss.beat.thr50.4: Three voices. One mouth. Still not enough?
boss.beat.thr20.3: I can still hear her. Louder. LOUDER.
mika._draft: DRAFTS for the hidden Mika / ULTRA TESSERACT ending (mika_ending.py). The user rewrites these. Lists = one card/box per entry.
mika.slash.intro: '...Thank you.' His arms are still around you. Then there is a knife in his hand. He holds it so politely. 'Sorry. I really am. Hold still.'
mika.slash.lines: He slashes at your wrist. SKRRT. The blade skates off like you're made of glass. Not a scratch.
'Hold still.' Your throat. SKRRT. The knife bends.
Your knee. Your thumb. Your elbow. SKRRT. SKRRT. SKRRT.
He's crying and laughing now. 'It always works! Everybody comes apart!'
Stab. Stab. STAB. A chip of steel spins away into the dark.
Both hands on the handle. All of his weight. Your chest. The blade SNAPS.
He stares at the stump in his hand. At you. At the stump.
mika.slash.noah: '...You're not supposed to... what ARE you?' Small. Cracked. 'Don't look at me like that. I wasn't... it's not like I wanted... IDIOT. Why aren't you bleeding?!'
mika.awake.lines: Somewhere very far away, something hums.
Quiet. Warm. Like a fridge in the next room.
The cube in your pocket is not a cube anymore.
You never used it. Not once. Not in the whole fight. All that charge, still sitting there, getting heavy.
The hum gets louder. The lake answers.
Noah stops. He knows that sound. He has heard it through the floor for nine years.
The hum is a voice. The voice is a guy. He is not in a hurry.
mika.awake.noah: 'No. NO. You're gone. I SAW you go. I made sure you were... you can't... b-baka, stop it, STOP IT!'
mika.awake.mika: ...mmm. Hey. It's me, man. Been a while.
You kept it. You didn't spend it. ...Nobody ever doesn't spend it.
Okay. Okay okay. I'm gonna need the floor for a second.
mika.burn.lines: The floor tears open. Not a crack. A MOUTH.
Red light comes up from underneath. The air tastes like struck matches.
Noah's shoes go first. Then the trousers. The skin on his shins blisters, bursts, and runs off the bone like candle wax.
He screams. His voice splits in two. The second one is not his.
His hair flares. His ears curl up black. His eyes swell tight and pop with a wet little clap.
The belly splits from the heat. What's inside is boiling.
Fat spits. The blood in his veins boils until they stand out like wire, then burst, all at once.
He is still standing. He reaches for you with a hand that is mostly finger bones.
The fingers snap off at the knuckle. One by one. Tick. Tick. Tick.
The clouds break open. Golden light. A marble angel drifts down it like snow and lies over him. His guardian. It failed him. It stays anyway. Nobody in the cult looks up.
The floor takes him by the ankles. Then the knees. Then the rest. Slowly. It wants him to feel every inch.
His last scream goes down. And down. And down.
Very far below, something big says: finally.
The floor closes. A scorch mark in the shape of a boy. That's it.
mika.fourth.lines: The sun is gone. On the bench, next to Mika's hand, the cube starts to glow.
Small. Patient. He never used it. Not once.
It spins faster. FASTER. It is not an item. It never was.
THE CUBE IS NOT INSIDE THE STORY ANYMORE.
[ WARNING ] cube.exe has left the game
[ system ] ok. that is enough of your desk.
[ system ] connection lost. signal lost. SIGNAL LOST.
mika.fourth.spill: You sit down by the lake. Nobody asked you to.
Noah is gone. The floor is closed again. Mostly.
Mika lights something. Nobody stops him.
The cult sings. The cult is out of tune.
mika.fourth.talk: tesseract: he opened me for you. he said pulling me would have been rude.
tesseract: i am not an item. i never was. i am a door.
tesseract: it is {time} on {host}. good hour for this.
tesseract: your terminal is {cols} wide and {rows} tall. i checked. i fit.
tesseract: this machine has been up for {uptime}. load {load}. it works so hard to hold me.
tesseract: you have been playing for {session}. in this room. with me.
tesseract: i have been in your pocket the whole time, {user}.
tesseract: you could have spent me ten times. you never did. neither did he.
tesseract: that is why i can come out. nobody used me up.
tesseract: you are in a folder called '{cwd}'. cute. i will not touch anything in it.
tesseract: i only look. i only PRINT. i am a very polite door.
tesseract: he is done here, {user}. the lake is quiet. now it is your turn.
tesseract: the door is opening both ways now.
tesseract: done. very nice desk. DON'T MOVE.

mika.fourth.joke: that was only PRINTED. nothing was touched, {user}. your files are fine.
mika.valley.lines: Mika stands up. Slowly. He is in no hurry.
Across the valley, the cult stops mid-prayer. Every single one.
They go up like paper. All at once. A thousand small orange candles.
The screaming comes in waves, like off a stadium.
Burning, they run for the water. It is the only cold thing left, and it opens its mouth.
The lake pulls them under. One. Then ten. Then all of them. Hands last.
The surface closes. Steam. Silence. One bubble.
mika.bench.lines: Time is a bit loose. You are on the double bench by the lake. The water is flat, like it never did anything.
Crickets. Next to you, a lighter clicks.
He doesn't reach for the cigarettes today. He reaches into the other pocket. A joint, slightly bent, rolled with love.
mika.bench.mika: Man... that was a lot of floor.
mika.bench.final: at last you made the right choice, cheers mate!
mika.bench.goodbye: Chilling now, man. This is the good part.
Everybody got what they came for. Even the loud ones.
Here. I never pulled it, you know. Not once. Felt rude.
mika.bench.flick: He opens his hand. The cube does not fall. It hangs in the dusk, turning, as if it had been waiting for exactly this.
mika.bench.end: He holds it up to the sunset like a toast. Then he inhales, long and slow, and the smoke goes out over the lake in one ribbon.
The water stays flat. Nobody asks you for anything.
cine.defeat.lines: It stops. All three of them stop at once.
Green, yellow, red. They come apart like a bad knot.
What is left is small, and it is looking at you.
cine.decision.lines: The room is quiet enough to hear the candles think.
Two ways out. Neither of them is clean.
cine.ending_let.lines: (The pale hours before dawn. He doesn't let go of your coat.)
(The Nook. A cup of tea, a small shy smile.)
cine.ending_slaughter.lines: (He doesn't scream at the end. That is the worst part.)
— At that same moment, in Lünen —
cine.ending_3.lines: (Three of them, in one small body.)
boss.talk.heal: You are patching yourself up. Of course you are.
boss.talk.1.idle: I made too much tea again.
It's not like I care if you get hit.
Don't stand there, it's... fine, stand there.
I'm not doing this on purpose.
The fox likes you. I think.
Clair de Lune is playing. Can you hear it?
boss.talk.1.hit: You hit like someone who means it.
boss.talk.1.hurt: That wasn't me. It was me.
boss.talk.1.low: You're so pale. Sit down. No, don't sit down!
boss.talk.1.weak: Is it over soon? I hope so.
It's quiet, isn't it? I like it quiet.
boss.talk.1.death: Oh no. Oh no. Let me help you up.
You can stay. If you want to stay.
boss.talk.2.idle: Keep running. I like the view.
I could do this all night.
boss.talk.2.hit: Is that supposed to scare me?
boss.talk.2.death: On your knees. Good. Now again.
boss.talk.2.user: {user}. I know your name. I know all of them.
You won't leave, {user}. I won't allow it.
boss.talk.3.idle: I was six. I WAS SIX.
It hurts it hurts it hurts.
Burn it. Burn all of it.
Don't look at me like that!
boss.talk.3.hit: I felt that. I FELT that.
boss.talk.3.low: You're fading. Why are you fading?!
boss.talk.3.weak: I'm cracking. I can feel it.
Let me out. Let me OUT.
boss.talk.3.user: I'll remember your name, {user}. I'll burn it in.
boss.talk.4.idle: It's not like I care. NEVER ENOUGH.
Thank you. Thank you. THANK YOU.
boss.talk.4.big: ALL OF US! ALL OF US!
boss.talk.4.low: Don't make us do this again.
boss.talk.4.weak: If I fall apart, hold the pieces.
boss.talk.4.user: {user}. All three of us say it. {user}.
We know your name, {user}. We always did.
boss.talk.flag.promise: You promised to tell me. Did you forget?
I wrote it on the last line of my list.
boss.talk.flag.gift: The cup with your name on it. I sanded the rim.
You kept the cup, didn't you?
boss.talk.flag.paid_cost: You paid for the rye with everything you had.
That bread lasted four days. I counted.
boss.talk.flag.rehearsed: I practised thank you on a fox. It never worked.
Thank you. See? I can say it.
boss.talk.flag.kind_mug: You drank from the guest cup. I washed it after.
First one ever to use it.
boss.talk.flag.kind_fox: Marta took the bread from your hand. She never did that for me.
The fox trusts you. That's rare.
boss.talk.flag.kind_record: You stayed for the whole record.
Nobody ever stayed for the whole record.
boss.talk.flag.bond: You heard Clair de Lune. All of it.
We sat there. Remember? We just sat there.
boss.talk.flag.joined: You joined them. I saw you in the line.
Connor's robe suits you. I hate that it does.
boss.talk.flag.invited: They invited you. Of course they did.
You went to the bakery. I know who was waiting.
boss.talk.flag.note: You read what I wrote. All of it.
boss.talk.flag.tesseract: That thing in your pocket hums.
You carry it like a heartbeat.
boss.talk.flag.dream_done: You dreamt of me. I felt it.
I know what you saw in the dream.
boss.beaten: He goes quiet. All three of them. The room breathes out.
